snippet.title: Lost in Cheese - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Lost in Cheese launches on Steam May 21, 2026.

Wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2341100/Lost_in_Cheese/

Lost in Cheese is a challenging puzzle adventure where a box-shaped cat named Mewton explore Roll Islands, solve puzzles, collect tokens, and uncover the secrets hidden deep within the cheese.

Built by developers with experience from studios like King and Paradox Interactive.

Features:
• Puzzle-focused gameplay
• Cozy adventure exploration
• Multiple themed worlds
• Character customization
• Secrets and collectibles

About Snøvittra:
